_metadata.description: Route preview, execution reasoning, and audit evidence.

requirements.title: Route preview explains provider selection before execution
requirements.description: Given a request role, profile, and constraints, the gateway must show the selected provider path, fallback candidates, rejected candidates, and policy reasons without executing inference.

validation.notes: Validates route preview candidate ordering, policy reasons, and fallback eligibility.
Validates preview RPC applies gateway request validation before routing.

requirements.title: Executed requests produce auditable route evidence
requirements.description: Each execution must emit structured evidence including request intent, role/profile, selected provider role, resource command path, resolved concrete model when available, latency, token/size metadata when available, and failure/fallback details.

validation.notes: Validates persistence and prompt/response redaction behavior for route evidence.
Validates execution fails closed when successful route evidence cannot be persisted.

requirements.title: Route evidence carries stable machine-readable outcome codes
requirements.description: Persisted route evidence must record stable codes for every major route outcome: rejection_reason, failure_class, breaker_state, capacity_verdict, capacity_claim_id, capacity_required_bytes, capacity_granted_bytes, capacity_reclaim_required, token counts, cost estimate, and selected resource role/model when the resource returns it. Existing evidence list/get contracts stay backward compatible and prompt/response text is never persisted.

validation.notes: Repository round-trip persists every structured code column; backward-compatible fields still round-trip and no prompt/response text is stored.
Service populates failure_class/rejection_reason/breaker_state per outcome (failed, blocked, half-open success) with redaction preserved.

requirements.title: Route evidence feeds descriptor-backed analytics measures
requirements.description: Route evidence must be promoted from audit-only data to declared measures computed from route_events SQL aggregates: route success rate/counts, fallback rate, provider failure rate, p95 latency or latency bucket summary, breaker-open count, and local capacity rejection count over a canonical time window. Measures are exposed through one shared compute path for the typed Connect MeasuresService and the /measures registry, declared in cli/manifest.json with governance and descriptor bindings, and the prior route_events measures waiver is removed. Measures provide analytics only and must not introduce hidden scoring.

validation.notes: SQL-aggregate math over route_events (counts, rates, p95, empty window) and shared Connect/registry compute path.

Connect MeasuresService RPCs and the /measures registry share one compute path. `measures-health validate scenario ai-gateway --probe` passes with the route_events waiver removed (Domain Coverage L3, Declaration Assembly L3, Behavioral Indexing L2, 0 errors).
